system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, every enemy within Near Range (15 ft) makes a CR 2 Wit Check. Each one that fails takes 5 Pierce damage and is knocked Prone and Maimed.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.95
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, every enemy within Near Range (15 ft) makes a CR 2 Wit Check. Each one that fails takes 5 Pierce damage and is knocked Prone and Maimed.

when.label: Enemies that failed the CR 2 Wit Check

automation.note: Target every enemy within Near Range (15 ft), then Use: each rolls the CR 2 Wit Check and is knocked Prone if it fails. Then target only the enemies that failed and click the Maimed button on the card. Each of them also takes 5 Pierce damage (Pierce skips armour rolls), applied by hand. No effect is given for a successful check.
